news.title: Kent celebrate promotion by beating Gloucestershire
news.description: Kent complete victory against Gloucestershire, with their promotion to Division One having already been confirmed by Northamptonshire's earlier defeat.

news.title: Coyote bite causes temporary closures in Cape Breton Highlands National Park
news.description: Sections of Cape Breton Highlands National Park are are temporarily closed after a visitor was bitten by a coyote on Thursday at MacIntosh Brook.

news.title: Former NFL QB says ‘nobody is playing the way Brock Purdy is right now’
news.description: San Francisco’s quarterback is looking like an early dark horse MVP option.

news.title: Crusaders beat Bangor after Wardell's late strike
news.description: Owen Wardell's late stunning strike is enough to see Crusaders overcome Bangor 2-1 at Seaview.
